name: OpenLEAF
description: OpenLEAF is a benchmark and framework for open-domain interleaved image-text generation, where models generate sequences of interleaved texts and images based on input queries. It includes an evaluation set assessed by large multi-modal models to measure entity and style consistencies in generated content.
reputation: A recent multimodal benchmark/framework that has attracted interest in interleaved image-text generation, but it is still relatively new and not yet widely standardized.
notes: Proposes both a generation framework and a benchmark with LMM-based evaluation validated by human assessment.
